title: KestrelCare Remainder Authorization: Amount Payable to the Facility
content:
**Calculation clause.** The amount payable on a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts remainder authorization starts from the repair estimate on the limited warranty decision. The plan's chosen deductible is subtracted from that starting amount, and the difference is never taken below zero. The figure is then capped at the plan's per-visit limit and at the coverage remaining on the plan, whichever is lower, and rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Inputs and where they are read

| Input | Record |
|---|---|
| Repair estimate | the estimate shown on the Kestrel limited warranty decision of the repair order |
| Chosen deductible | the deductible recorded on the KestrelCare plan at its sale |
| Per-visit limit | the per-repair-visit limit of the plan's coverage level |
| Coverage remaining | the coverage remaining shown on the plan when the authorization is made |

## The figure, in order

1. Take the starting amount and subtract the chosen deductible; a negative difference counts as zero.
2. Compare that figure with the per-visit limit and with the coverage remaining; the lowest of the three is the amount payable.
3. Round to the cent once, at the end. Intermediate figures are carried unrounded.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

| Case | Starting amount | Chosen deductible | After the deductible | Per-visit limit | Coverage remaining | Amount payable |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 2846.37 | 100.00 | 2746.37 | 6500.00 | 11200.00 | 2746.37 |
| B | 9180.00 | 250.00 | 8930.00 | 8000.00 | 4415.50 | 4415.50 |
| C | 80.00 | 100.00 | 0.00 | 3500.00 | 7000.00 | 0.00 |

In case B the coverage remaining is the lower of the two caps; in case C the deductible exceeds the starting amount and the difference is held at zero.
